notes.title: 0.4 Version Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Card Pool System Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p]The card pool now has a fixed set of cards. Drawing cards no longer reduces the card pool, and selling cards does not add to it. The number of cards in the pool only affects card refresh rates.[/p][/*][*][p]Duplicate cards will no longer appear when discovering cards.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Support Card System Overhaul[/b]
Support cards are now categorized into three types:[/p][list][*][p][b]Normal Support Cards[/b]: Removed after use.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Persistent Support Cards[/b]: Remain permanently after use.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Equipment Support Cards[/b]: Can be equipped to characters, with a maximum of 3 per character.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Equipment Card Synthesis[/b] function: A synthesis button appears automatically when a player has all required materials for an equipment card.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Synthesis Table View[/b] function: Accessible via a button above the guide on the right side of the battle interface.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Traits Added[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Unique[/b]: Only one copy of the same character's original skill takes effect among characters with the same name.[/p][list][*][p]Applied to: Zhuge Zhan, Sima Yi, Lu Kang, Kaimi Hime, He Lingsi.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Illusion[/b]: The character is destroyed upon taking any damage (including armor damage).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Card Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Wei Yan[/b]: Gains the [b]Double Strike[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guan Yu[/b]: Skill healing effect removed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zhuge Zhan[/b]: Skill changed to "Friendly characters' Breakthrough skills trigger an additional time."[/p][/*][*][p][b]Uesugi Kenshin[/b]: Skill boost adjusted to (1/1).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ling Tong[/b]: Skill changed to "Before action: Summon 1 \[Hengjiang Archer]. notes.title: 0.3.4 Version Update
notes.content:
[code]▶ New Feature
Overdrive Mode: Continuous battle acceleration now triggers Overdrive State (dramatically increases combat pace)7.

▶ New Achievement
Endless Covenant: Clear Floor 40 of Endless Hell (unlocks exclusive title)510.

▶ New Hero
Liu Ying: Triggers Prep Phase skills of all allies once1.

▶ New Role Cards
Liu Shan: On Sell → Refreshes Hero's active skill (assist utility)27.

Zhang Lu: On Play → Consumes all Points, each Point grants all allies +3 CP38.

Bian Yu'er: When ally takes damage → 4 random allies gain +1 to all attributes (ATK/DEF/SE).

Sun Luyu: Prep Start → Adjacent allies gain +3 to all attributes and return to hand.

Ii Naotora: Combat Start → Critical Damage +1 for all Warring States roles (faction buff).

▶ Skill Changes
Diaochan Rework: Pre-action → Summons 1 original enemy role, forcing it to attack immediately (counter-control)2.

Lü Bu Adjust:

Post-attack → Deals 50% of excess damage to all enemies.

When ally attacks with lower CP → Lü Bu permanently gains their base attributes2.

Xu Shu Adjust: On Play → Draws 1 random 【Shu】role card (≤ current shop tier)49.

▶ Bug Fixes
Fixed inability to open Settings after combat failure.

Fixed loss of Gloomy Dungeon bonuses after triple-promotion5.[/code]

notes.title: 0.1.8 Version Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Mechanics[/h1]

Spirit Power (霊能 - Reinou): When a character deals skill damage, additional damage equal to their Spirit Power is dealt.

[h1]New Character Cards[/h1]

Bao Sanniang (打出 - Play): Removes herself and the character to her left. Summons a random Shu character whose star level equals the combined star levels of the removed characters. Gains base stats equal to the combined base stats of the removed characters.

Gu Yong (陣亡 - Death): The rightmost allied character gains +1 Spirit Power.

Hao Zhao (陣亡 - Death): Deals damage to a random enemy equal to [Number of your Permanent Support Cards] × 1.

He Lingsi (我方战斗中召唤角色时 - When you summon a character during battle): That summoned character's ATK and DEF are doubled.

Tachibana Dōsetsu (战斗开始时 - Start of Battle): All allied Sengoku characters gain Spirit Power equal to [Number of your Permanent Support Cards] × 1.

Xun You (打出 - Play): Gains 2 [Fertile Field] cards.

Iga Ninja (召唤 - Summon): A random allied character gains [Hidden].

Zhang Mancheng (回合结束时 - End of Turn): All Yellow Turban characters summoned during this game permanently gain +1/+1.

Zhu Ran (战斗开始时 - Start of Battle): Permanently gains +1 Spirit Power. Characters summoned during battle gain Spirit Power equal to his current Spirit Power.

Zhuge Zhan (陣亡 - Death): Triggers the Break Enemy skill of all allied characters once.

[h1]New Support Cards[/h1]

Spirit Power Surge: Give an allied character +2 Spirit Power.

Miracle Egg: Give an allied character the skill: [Death: Randomly summon 1 character from the same faction with star level -1].

[h1]Balance Adjustments[/h1]

Huang Gai's skill has been changed to (行动结束后 - After Action): Deals 1 damage to himself and permanently gains +3 DEF.

Huang Gai gains the keyword [Combo].

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

Fixed an issue where selling cards in the Market would incorrectly reduce the number of cards by an extra amount.
